hotel_name: Via Singh Suite - Hotel In Dlf Phase 3, Gurgaon

positive_snippets:
Had a fantastic stay at FabHotel Singh Suite, DLF Phase 3. The rooms were clean, well-maintained, and comfortable. The staff provided excellent service — polite, prompt, and always helpful. The location is convenient, close to key spots in Gurgaon, though a bit more signage outside would help.
Highly recommended for both business and leisure stays. Great value for money!

I had an exceptional stay at your hotel. From the moment I arrived, the staff was warm, welcoming, and professional. The check-in process was seamless, and the room was immaculate, spacious, and elegantly designed with all the modern amenities I could ask for.

The staff in the hotel was very friendly and the environment was also good. Facilities there was too good. I enjoyed the vacation there with my family and with comparable low expenses as the price there were reasonable
negative_snippets:
Extremely disappointed with the condition of the hotel. The rooms and toilets were very unclean, and the bed sheets and towels were in poor condition. There was also a strong cigarette smell throughout the room, making it absolutely unsuitable for a family stay.

Additionally, the breakfast provided was of very poor quality. Though the booking was made for 2 nights, had no choice but to vacate the hotel this morning and move to another accommodation.

Kindly cancel the remaining one night stay. We request you to initiate a refund for the unused night at the earliest.

Worst. Absolutely worst. None of the ACs worked in any of the rooms. Beds, sheets and rooms were unsanitary. There was dust and mold everywhere. Floor was also not clean. It was full of dust. The bare essentials like towers, soap, sanitary kits weren't provided. They should close up shop.
